UX Designer - Mossgate Software

About the role
Mossgate builds scheduling software for service businesses and is growing its design team. The team works in two-week sprints, holds weekly demos and keeps documentation next to the code. Engineers pair often, give honest feedback and set aside time every sprint to improve tooling, and new colleagues are paired with a buddy for their first month.

Responsibilities
- Own end-to-end design of product features
- Run research and testing
- Maintain the design system

Requirements
- Figma
- User research
- Prototyping
- Design systems
- Accessibility knowledge

Nice to have
- Motion design

Benefits
- Flexible working hours and a yearly learning budget
- 25 days of paid leave plus public holidays
- We review every application and reply within two weeks
